Meta.creditsDescription: One-time Korea Concierge Trip Passes with fixed credit prices for premium personalization.

Credits.eyebrow: One-time Trip Passes · No monthly subscription at launch
Credits.title: Buy credits once. Use them only when premium personalization is worth it.
Credits.intro: Public travel discovery and useful cultural guidance stay free. Premium actions use fixed credits shown before confirmation, so model or token usage never changes what you pay for that action.
Credits.catalogNotice: These launch prices come from the authoritative in-repo credit catalog. Live checkout is not enabled yet; wallet and payment controls arrive in later gated steps.
Credits.passesIntro: Trip Passes are one-time purchases, not auto-renewing subscriptions. Advanced is the recommended starting point for a multi-day trip.

basic.name: Basic
basic.description: For a short trip with a few premium personalized actions.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: For a multi-day trip using styling, culture and itinerary features.

ultra.name: Ultra
ultra.description: For couples, families or frequent premium personalization during one trip.

Credits.refillsIntro: Refills are intended after you already understand how credits work. Main Trip Passes remain the better initial value.
Credits.actionsTitle: Fixed credit prices before every premium action
Credits.actionsIntro: Customer charges are fixed by feature. Token counts and provider prices never create surprise variable billing.
Credits.serverBody: The browser must never mint credits, change catalog prices or edit balances. Production wallet mutations will be authorized on the server.
Credits.reserveBody: A paid action will reserve its fixed credits, capture them only on success, and release them automatically on failure.
Credits.paymentBody: The payment foundation will target overseas cards and PayPal through a Korea-compatible provider. No live checkout is implied on this preview page.
Credits.pricingBody: Launch prices are public and fixed. We will not use nationality, profile traits or an ML pricing model to change what one traveler pays versus another.
Credits.freeBody: Public discovery, first basic personal-color scan and basic zodiac experiences remain free according to the current launch policy.
Credits.technicalNote: Internal model/provider costs are monitored separately. Travelers buy useful outcomes, not raw tokens.
